note: Authored from docs/spec; expected facts are derived by tools/fixtures/movement, not by packages/core. No state or draw hashes: later entries assert those.
tick: 60 Hz fixed; phases input, waits, threads, movement, edges, triggers, animation (AD-26)
units: board pixels; fractions are exact multiples of 1/256

cases.name: step-on-once-per-entry-and-rearm
cases.note: E-40: fires once on entering, not again while inside, and re-arms after the player leaves.

cases.name: repeat-distance
cases.note: E-42: fires on entry, then again each distanceRepeat (64) px walked inside; the counter resets on leaving.

cases.name: key-press-versus-step-on
cases.note: E-41: a key-press region does not fire on entry; each activation key press inside fires it. A step region overlapping it fires on entry only.

cases.name: layer-matching
cases.note: A region on layer 1 is ignored by a player on layer 0 and fires for a player on layer 1.

cases.name: layer-one-player-fires
cases.note: The same region fires when the controlled player is on layer 1.

cases.name: last-region-in-board-order-wins
cases.note: Activation: among matching regions the last in stored board order wins; the earlier one is not marked fired.

cases.name: items-before-regions-front-then-nearest
cases.note: R-52 item 2: items are chosen before regions; the item most directly in front (facing E) wins over a nearer item beside the player; a region under both is ignored.

cases.name: equal-front-and-distance-lowest-index
cases.note: R-52 item 2: equal in-front value and equal distance, the lowest compacted runtime item index wins.

cases.name: condition-failure-falls-through
cases.note: R-52 item 1: a failed condition removes the candidate without consuming the event, so the earlier unconditional region fires.

cases.name: run-once-condition-before-set-after
cases.note: E-44 and R-52 item 4: the condition is tested before the program and the variable set after it; leaving and re-entering does not fire again.

cases.name: aborted-program-does-not-set
cases.note: R-52 item 4: a program aborted by an unhandled error does not set its variable.

cases.name: stop-movement-clears-queue
cases.note: A region flagged stop-movement clears the player's queued movement before running.

cases.name: gone-suppresses-until-board-left
cases.note: Reawakened gone rule: gone() suppresses only this trigger until the board is left; the region stays on the board.

cases.name: movement-inside-a-trigger-is-silent
cases.note: E-45: movement started inside a running trigger fires no other trigger; the region ahead stays silent while the program walks the player through it.

cases.name: hidden-item-is-not-a-candidate
cases.note: E-45: an item whose loading condition fails is hidden and offers no activation until shown by script.
